problem.title: Free Subgroups Avoiding All Dehn-Surgery Kernels
problem.statement:
Let $K\subset S^3$ be a hyperbolic knot with no finite surgery, and let $G(K)=\pi_1(S^3\setminus K)$. Does there exist a rank-two free subgroup $H\subset G(K)$ such that

$$H\cap\bigcup_{r\in\mathbb Q}\langle\!\langle r\rangle\!\rangle=\{1\},$$

where $\langle\!\langle r\rangle\!\rangle$ is the normal closure of the slope $r$?

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-22)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** Existing results produce infinitely many cyclic subgroups with the required disjointness, but the requested rank two free subgroup is still posed as an open question for hyperbolic knots without finite surgery.

- [Oberwolfach Report 8/2020](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/46844)
